answer: Each identity must climb a loan ladder: borrow and repay 12 escalating microloans, from 1 to 24 coins, each from a different established lender over 12 weeks, with every repayment hash-posted before the next rung unlocks. Lenders risk real capital and charge about 8% interest, and a whisper of default freezes the ladder and cancels the slot. Crossing this canyon cannot be parallelised: 1,000 Sybils need 12,000 separate loans, about 12,000 coins total in interest, and 12,000 lender decisions risking real funds. Trade-off: honest newcomers start tiny and climb slowly, one ridge at a time.
